implementation: Junos OS Evolved OpenSSL Cryptographic Module (SSH_SSSE3)
description: OpenSSL library implementation providing cryptographic services to Linux user space software components. The module was tested with 64 bit word size. The following cipher implementation is covered: SSH KDF using SSSE3 SHA implementation.
